concept: Non-critical appliance replacement part catalog by model/part number
solution: Tested physical parts plus optional STL; narrowly exclude electrical, hot-water, pressure and load-bearing components.
independent_demand_signals: Etsy has 464+ appliance-part items and listings with review counts; observed requests for discontinued consumer parts.
red_team_view: Strong current competition. Fragmented part/model compatibility creates a data moat; support and shipping are main workload.

solution: Personalized removable fence-mounted bag hook/caddy sold in batches through team managers.
independent_demand_signals: Live Finnish example, Reppukoukku, demonstrates product and team-appropriate positioning; no public sales figures checked.
red_team_view: Copyable, seasonal, easy for club managers to share; must avoid sharp edges and fence damage.
likely_distribution: Club managers and sporting goods shops

solution: Catalog of safe non-branded generic tokens/dice/cubes and referral to publisher for branded pieces.
independent_demand_signals: Multiple consumer posts cite missing components; Finnish retailer and maker service document existing service/prices.
red_team_view: Publisher replacements and existing services compete; copyright/trademark limits restrict replicas.

concept: Model-train discontinued low-risk shells and cosmetic parts
solution: Small-batch, scale-verified shells, covers and cosmetic connectors; no electrical running gear at first.
independent_demand_signals: Several model-train and model-kit threads report missing/discontinued parts; €70 example reported for G-scale shell/chassis.
red_team_view: Small audience; strong design/IP risk; accurate reverse engineering takes hours.

concept: Bicycle fitment adapter finder and non-critical organizers
solution: Compatibility lookup and small organizers/positioning accessories; avoid load-bearing, brake and safety parts.
independent_demand_signals: Multiple cycling discussions document mount conflicts; commercial adapters already retail near €14 and many competing Etsy listings.
red_team_view: Already competitive; differentiation must solve exact geometry and avoid unsafe mounting.
likely_distribution: Bike shops; fitment guide QR at point of sale

concept: Repair-shop part identification intake form + quote-ready data export
solution: A simple form that collects model/serial, photo and dimensions, then produces normalized part request or quote sheet.
independent_demand_signals: Shop employee reports 5–20 weekly discontinued-part requests; repair source says serial revisions complicate fitment.
red_team_view: Could be solved with existing CRM/forms; needs shop workflow and data privacy.

concept: Small-run replacement stock exchange for repair shops
solution: Shared, searchable stock list of donor parts and verified cross-reference codes, with no manufacturing.
independent_demand_signals: Multiple threads show donor sourcing via eBay, social groups and local repair storerooms.
red_team_view: Cold-start problem, shipping and inventory freshness; no transaction evidence.

buyer_group: Cyclists using computer, lights, camera and phone
solution: Pretested low-profile bundle matching common standards with clear fitment selector.
independent_demand_signals: Public retailer sells Garmin/Wahoo/Bryton to Quad Lock adapter for €14; Etsy has 44+ related listings.
red_team_view: Demand exists and competition is visible; product liability if device detaches; only non-critical/retention testing.

concept: Vintage camera/lens cap and hot-shoe accessory micro-catalog
solution: Model-specific caps, covers and non-electrical mounts from measured templates.
independent_demand_signals: Need signals from hobby forums and replacement parts searches; direct purchasing evidence weak in this evidence set.
red_team_view: Avoid claiming camera-specific demand without additional validation; model fragmentation.

concept: Sahti / home-brew batch labeling and reusable tap markers
solution: Waterproof batch, keg and tap labels with QR recipe/log link, sized for local brewing equipment.
independent_demand_signals: No direct demand observation captured in this initial evidence set; plausible adjacent audience only.
red_team_view: Wild card requiring interviews/preorders; food-contact safety excluded.

concept: Small workshop custom hose/port adapter kit
buyer_group: Repair shops, vacuum and hot-tub technicians
solution: A curated range of safe, non-pressure adapters and dimensioned CAD files.
business_model: Physical kit, digital CAD, shop bundles
independent_demand_signals: 3D printing users report vacuum hose adapters and bespoke tool parts as practical use cases.
red_team_view: Generic online competition; pressure/chemical/heat limits must be explicit.

concept: Sports-team equipment cage labeling and personal gear stations
solution: Personalized bag hooks plus name/number labels and QR lost-and-found tags as one team order.
independent_demand_signals: Reppukoukku illustrates club-level product fit; no second independent documented customer-demand signal gathered.
red_team_view: Seasonal demand and fast copyability; bundle increases average order value, personalization adds fulfilment.

concept: Board-game club shared spare-parts cabinet and reorder kit
solution: A low-cost labeled kit for common generic pieces with an inventory QR request workflow.
independent_demand_signals: Missing components repeatedly disrupt games; existing publisher service only covers some situations.
red_team_view: Generic pieces cannot replace copyrighted unique art; volume and replacements per site unknown.

concept: Model-specific 10-inch homelab mounting and cable map kits
buyer_group: Home-lab users and small IT integrators
solution: Non-load-bearing faceplates, cable labels and fitted cable guides for common mini-PC/rack combinations.
independent_demand_signals: Earlier repository work covered home-lab accessories; this problem search did not independently establish willingness to pay.
red_team_view: Competition likely; rack mounts can be load-bearing; narrow to low-risk labels/guides.

concept: Analog asset maintenance QR pack for seasonal boats/cabins
solution: Weatherproof QR tags connected to printable service log and checklist templates.
business_model: Physical pack + digital template, installer batch
independent_demand_signals: No direct observation in initial data; concept tests a digital/physical combination and partner channel.
red_team_view: QR records may expose personal data; incumbents include generic labels/forms; demand needs paid test.
likely_distribution: Marinas and seasonal property service firms
